target_customer: Go-to-market, risk and compliance teams that need verified data on people and companies
problem: Contact and entity data from databases is incomplete; teams need agents that research open web, records and proprietary sources and resolve identities.
business_model: Usage-based API and platform subscription for data enrichment and research agents
product_category: AI agent data enrichment and entity intelligence

founders.name: Saarth Shah
founders.background_notes: Former data science researcher at Stanford Snyder Institute and San Diego Supercomputer Center per YC page.

founders.name: Christopher Price
founders.background_notes: Won an AI CalHacks competition per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating web research agents with identity resolution and source verification is moderately hard; relies on third-party models and data sources.

defensibility.rationale: Quality of resolved entity data could compound, but agents over public sources are copyable and Clay-style tools were adjacent.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying documented in sources found; the company shifted its messaging toward risk and compliance use cases by 2026 per its YC description.

market_need_then: Sales and risk teams relied on static data vendors; a customer case study claims Apollo found contacts for about 25% of accounts versus 75% with Sixtyfour (vendor claim).

branding.domain_note: Uses sixtyfour.ai; acquisition details not found.

identity.logo: Lockup of name with a standalone mark; black on light and inverse versions per brand page
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and direct; tagline 'We resolve identities'

branding.brand_signature: A public brand page with downloadable lockup and mark

brand_strength.rationale: Brand page exists but no press or community about the brand; name origin unknown.

pivots.to: Intelligence infrastructure on people and entities for risk and data quality teams
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred only from differing company descriptions, so treat as unconfirmed

outcome_analysis: Sixtyfour is an early-stage company from the Spring 2025 batch with a 12 person team and an API product used by sales and risk teams. The only funding found is an unverified aggregator-reported $500K pre-seed, so its fundraising trajectory is unknown. It is active with product releases through November 2026 and no exit.
notes: Company website fetch was blocked by the rate-limited safety check; used search snippets and YC page.
